changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Code Generation' as the paper focuses on semantic parsing/SQL generation, not general code generation. Added 'Text-to-SQL' as a more specific task description. Normalized model names and dataset names to standard forms. Added BERT variants that were tested alongside TaBERT.
Normalized all variations to consistent capitalization format. Kept only the base metrics without duplicates.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this 2020 paper (predating widespread use of LLMs for evaluation). Original extraction was correct.
No human evaluation was conducted in the paper. The evaluation relies entirely on automatic metrics (execution accuracy and exact match).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on semantic parsing/text-to-SQL generation using the TaBERT model. Evaluation is based on automatic metrics (execution accuracy and exact match) without human evaluation or LLM-as-judge assessment. The extraction was mostly accurate but needed normalization of names and clarification that 'Code Generation' was too broad for this specific task.
